material_type: Diplonema papillatum (ATCC 50162) was originally obtained from the American Type Culture Collection (ATCC) and cultivated axenically without shaking at 15–22°C in ocean salt medium (OS) containing 33 g/l Instant Ocean Sea Salt (Instant Ocean) and supplemented with 1% (v/v) horse serum as described earlier.

species.evidence: Affinity pulldown of mitoribosomal complexes from Diplonema papillatum, the diplonemid type species, demonstrates that they have a mass of > 5 MDa, contain as many as 130 integral proteins, and exhibit a protein-to-RNA ratio of 11:1.
